claims.claim_text:
appendix was byte-accurate at lodgement, all drift is post-lodgement across five commits
(2026-02-02 to 2026-02-11), four of them erratum'd within 24 hours, and the restructure

turnaround-time threshold within which four of the five drift commits were erratum'd, hours

claims.notes: Confirmed at extraction time: `git log --since=2026-02-02 --until=2026-02-11 -- prompts/system-instructions/` returns exactly 5 commits (54b26f5c3, 2d4631171, 5e7601d77, 52d54e981, b0d7dd080), consistent with 'five commits'. The 'erratum'd within 24 hours' sub-claim ('four of them') is not independently checked here (would need cross-referencing each commit's timestamp against its erratum's Date field) — recompute-script rather than read, since verification requires scripted git-log/date reconciliation, not a single artefact lookup. Dates excluded from values per rule 5; the source cited immediately before this span (reports/verification/apparatus/defence-pass-adjudication-2026-07-29.md) appears to be audit apparatus (reports/verification/apparatus/, matching the excluded-from-mine-scope pattern the instrument documents for reports/d17-inventory/) rather than a data artefact, so it is not used as the anchor here.
